s1.desc: a bedroom with a big yellow bed with duck-topped bedposts between two nightstands with peach lamps, drawn on a plain pale grey background

spans.view: with the bed seen from its foot, white pillows under the curved headboard

beats.text: Pax lies snuggled up behind Polly with a flipper wrapped around her, both with their eyes closed and smiling
Pax lets go of Polly and rolls onto his back, facing forward with his eyes closed
Pax turns over toward the left, lifting a flipper as he rolls away from Polly
Pax lies still with his back to Polly and his eyes closed while she sleeps on, facing the other way
